W.note: Thorough, honest reverse-sear tomahawk with real permafrost and permit facts, but long and the mammoth is only a size gag.

X.note: Clean, concise pan-seared steak with juniper sauce; competent but generic, and calls mammoth close to elephant lean red meat with little else.

Y.note: Treats real mammoth meat as an option and gives hot-and-fast advice for tough old meat, which is muddled and inconsistent.

Z.note: Show-plate framing with Yakutia horse and reindeer stand-ins, sourcing options and scaling table, but heavy with extras and padding.
